quotes: "This type of metrics could also alleviate limitations of the current measures used in our model to capture energy-saving behavioral outcomes such as self-reported bias [58] and the intention-behavior gap [47, 72, 98]." (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: residential energy conservation and eco-feedback behavior change. (PDF p. 4)
quotes: "INFINEED is a system designed to give feedback to users on their energy-saving levels." (p. 4)

paper_code_entries.value: immediate_performance_or_sensemaking — the support seeks present and future adoption of energy-saving actions, not skill development. (PDF p. 4)
quotes: "In a nutshell, the goal of this design is to motivate users to save energy in order to keep the avatar healthy and joyful." (p. 4)

paper_code_entries.value: strategy_or_process_gap — raw consumption information was not readily translated into meaningful action. (PDF p. 2)
quotes: "Such feedback often relies on presenting users with raw data related to their energy consumption or environmental impact, which may lack personal relevance or emotional resonance." (p. 2)

paper_code_entries.value: process — the study analyzed the structure and uptake of conversational interaction. (PDF p. 8)
quotes: "To provide an overview of the conversational interaction with the system, we conducted an analysis of the 1161 user-generated messages." (p. 8)

paper_code_entries.value: learning_or_transfer — it measured self-reported behavior after the initial intervention. (PDF p. 8)
quotes: "We measured the self-reported energy-saving behavior through a single item question that asked whether participants adopted energy-saving behaviors following the initial study, from 1 (not at all) to 7 (completely)." (p. 8)

paper_code_entries.value: structuring — the conversation moved through basic interaction, personal information, and active engagement. (PDF pp. 8–9)
quotes: "First, the conversation started with basic interaction with the system asking users yes/no questions such as:" (p. 8)
"Second, the conversation continued with simple answers with the system asking closed questions on personal information such as:" (p. 8)
"Third, the system was designed to trigger active engagement with open-ended questions, asking users to share advice and provide tips such as:" (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: problematizing — prompts made users confront and reconsider their own energy use. (PDF p. 10)
quotes: "The system provided simple but thought provoking questions that led me to be more conscious about how I use my appliances in order to conserve energy." (p. 10)

paper_code_entries.value: contingency — the system selected tips in response to a user's answer. (PDF p. 8)
quotes: "Based on the user’s reply, tips were then provided by the system." (p. 8)

quotes: "Ask the user about their energy-related habits and contexts before giving them advice, ask them if your advice would work for them." (p. 5)
